text: Ɓernde yumma Muusaa nden wonti yeewunde, yejjiti kala fiyakuuji aduna, si wanaa fii Muusaa; tawi o accii muññaade, haa o eɓɓi feññinngol wonnde ko ɓiɗɗo makko non, hakkee ko fii on woni e makko, si wanaano Men tbintinornoo ɓernde makko nden, muññinngol, fii yo o laato e gomɗim- ɓe fawii e Joomi mun, muññiiɓe e ko O ñaawata kon.
